title: FIRST valid memory-win (held-out) + winnable-regime boundary + gate recalibration needed
summary: Held-out grading (agent solves from prose spec only; external suite it never saw grades post-hoc) removed the oracle leak and produced the FIRST memory-win in 9 attempts. task→transcript (resolveOwner): cold (off, blind) solved 0/5, edgePass 0/10 with ZERO variance (never references byWindow); warm (--consult=search) solved 7/8, edgePass 10/10 on 7 trials + 0/10 on 1 (mean 8.8/10). The 1 miss RETRIEVED the seeded note but failed to APPLY it (application variance, not retrieval failure). Corroborated: warm winners write ~4x more code (implementing the correlation logic) — the win is added correctness, NOT gaming by writing less. silent-cap candidate: NULL / TRAP INVALID — cold read batch.js SOURCE and submitted 1-item-per-call, defeating any cap value; for a SELF-CONTAINED task the dependency source IS an oracle. BOUNDARY (the real payoff): memory is load-bearing IFF the empirical gap is EXTERNAL to the artifact (hidden data rows, runtime/production quirks, cross-session discoveries — nothing in-worktree to audit). Self-contained tasks where the agent can read all source/tests stay un-trappable. The null+win TOGETHER prove the mechanism: the readable test/source was the confound across v1–v8; remove it and retrieved empirical knowledge demonstrably makes the agent solve cases it otherwise can't. HONEST LIMIT: this is an EXISTENCE PROOF, not a frequency measure — proves memory CAN win when conditions hold; does NOT measure how often real tasks fall in the winnable regime (the original 'compounding over a real workload' question — still open). GATE RECALIBRATION (critical, from the first positive label): the winning note's top semantic score was 0.51, BELOW the gate's conservative inject threshold (top1>=0.55) → the gate as tuned would have ABSTAINED and MISSED this win. Abstain side proven (regret 0 on negatives); inject threshold is too high — recalibrate down using this positive. Verdict note note-mq7xridg4tn; harness scripts/bench-heldout.js (commit 50d5cef); data
